page.overview:
Who is Chastity Chase?

Chastity Chase is a fictional intelligence operative employed by the British Secret Intelligence Service (SIS/MI6). The character appeared in the 2015 video-game, James Bond: World of Espionage.

Having explored much of her natal continent by the age of eighteen, Chastity continued her expeditions throughout the Middle East and then into Europe as an undergraduate reading Anthropology. Her disruption of a German-run poaching ring drew the attention of MI6 who then relentlessly pursued her as an agent. After refusing their advances on numerous occasions, she had a change of heart and now works tirelessly to protect British interests wherever they are threatened.

She is skilled in firearms, survival and driving, and is multi-lingual, speaking English, Swahili, Dutch and German. The character offers an increased critical damage buff and provides a +10 total offence bonus using double-action pistols and +10 total offence using silencers. She is a 'common agent' (white) and can be levelled to level 5.
